schedule.note: Practice problems worked in class before the final

assignments.name: Problem sets
assignments.description: Six weekly sets of business problems, solved in Excel or Python and submitted on Canvas. Students could work through them with their assigned MSBA group but submitted individually. The problems include who wins a seven-game World Series, how long it takes to roll doubles to get out of jail in Monopoly, how many ambulances a service needs when calls arrive every 75 minutes on average, value at risk for a portfolio, lognormal insurance claims, and whether coffee and soda prices move together.

assignments.name: Final exam
assignments.description: An open-book, open-notes exam taken on Canvas in the final exam period, with questions modeled on the problem sets, quizzes, and class examples.

assignments.name: In-class quizzes
assignments.description: Fifteen to twenty one-point quizzes taken on laptops during class, using the ideas covered that day.

assignments.name: Section quizzes
assignments.description: Three optional Canvas quizzes, each covering the previous two weeks of material.

assignments.name: Practice sets, summaries, and walkthrough videos
assignments.description: Added halfway through the term: practice problem sets with solutions for interval estimation, hypothesis testing, and regression, a written summary of each module and a combined formula sheet, and recorded walkthroughs of the harder problems, such as the airline overbooking expected value problem.
